answer: A single stage of dynamic chunking matches a strong BPE Transformer at sizes exceeding 1B parameters [Dynamic Chunking for End-to-End Hierarchical Sequence Modeling, arXiv:2507.07955v2, PDF p. 3, §1 −'!"$]. The dynamic chunking module compresses data to a resolution of 4.5-5 bytes per chunk [Dynamic Chunking for End-to-End Hierarchical Sequence Modeling, arXiv:2507.07955v2, PDF p. 3, §1 −'!"$].
question: A single stage of dynamic chunking is trained on raw bytes. Above what size does it match a strong BPE Transformer, and about how many bytes land in one learned chunk?
raw_answer: A single stage of dynamic chunking matches a strong BPE Transformer at sizes exceeding 1B parameters [[cite:b442289c4f7e2e01]]. The dynamic chunking module compresses data to a resolution of 4.5-5 bytes per chunk [[cite:b442289c4f7e2e01]].
